pattern: ONE cold end-to-end chain, reused by every claim about its RESULT
the determinism claim keeps TWO independent executions
the zero-image claim keeps its own execution, because its INPUT differs
one shared chain helper so three modules assert against one implementation
split_rationale: splitting only helps when the modules do not each rebuild the same fixture. These three build DIFFERENT things, so the split lowers the shard floor without duplicating work.
